thread:
ana (Support): Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 5xx + client timeouts to hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC. CS has 3 escalations (tenant-88, tenant-211, tenant-acme). Logs attached from support console.
kevin (SRE): Acknowledged. Spinning up triage. Observability links? :eyes:
support-bot: Alert: tenant-88 saw 12 5xx and 7 timeouts in last 10m (gateway).
danny (Infra): Gateway is returning 503s fronting runtime pools. Traffic spike at 09:08 caused request queue growth in batcher. Node CPU and NIC look normal.
maria (Runtime): Runtime reports a lot of upstream grpc timeouts to model workers: "grpc: code = Unknown desc = upstream timeout". KV cache hit rate dropped ~40% which could explain increased work per request.
liam (Oncall): I'm enabling autoscale bump + activating additional dedicated pool for hosted-tenants to relieve pressure. Will also raise the gateway circuit-breaker threshold temporarily.
kevin (SRE): Can we toggle reject-after to avoid long tails? propose: `gateway.reject_after_ms = 8000` and `gateway.circuit_breaker.open_threshold = 0.7` (apply for 15m).
maria (Runtime): Also recommend turning on model-fallback for heavy requests to smaller quantized variant: `model_fallback: enable=true, fallback_model=redwood-small-q4` — reduces per-token latency.
nana (Support): ping on customer comms: telling them we're investigating and mitigating.
danny (Infra): Applied gateway.reject_after_ms=8000 at 09:22 UTC. Circuit breaker threshold bumped to 0.72. Autoscale completed at 09:25, added 6 nodes to hosted pool.
kevin (SRE): After mitigation, 5xx rate dropped from 6.3% to 1.1% within 6m. Timeouts reduced but still seeing sporadic tail. Collecting p95/p99 traces now. :thumbsup:
maria (Runtime): Found a regression in the kv-cache eviction heuristic that kicked in under high concurrency. Patch prepared to restore previous heuristic; will ship canary to 10% of runtime pool.
liam (Oncall): Canary deployed at 09:40. Initial metrics look good for those instances.
nana (Support): Sent interim update to affected customers at 09:45 UTC: "we're seeing reduced errors, mitigation in place, full follow-up planned."
kevin (SRE): Next steps: 1) Promote kv-cache heuristic rollback across runtime (SRE+Runtime) 2) Postmortem with root cause and timeline (owners: kevin + ana) 3) Explore longer-term fixes: better kv-cache telemetry, prefix caching for hot prompts, and smarter batcher admission control.
maria (Runtime): Action item: cut a hotfix PR for cache heuristic rollback (PR: #4729), run integration test, then promote. Expected ETA 2h.
danny (Infra): Action item: review autoscale thresholds; propose earlier scale triggers on request queue length > 40 for 3m.
liam (Oncall): I'll run the post-deploy smoke and monitor p99 for 30m after the hotfix promote.
kevin (SRE): Customer impact tally: tenant-88 ~120 requests failed, tenant-211 ~40, tenant-acme ~16. We'll coordinate credits/compensation from CS after RCA.
nana (Support): Filing customer follow-up templates and linking to incident doc.
kevin (SRE): Thanks team. I'll keep this thread open until hotfix is promoted and p99 stabilized. For the postmortem, include metrics: kv-cache hit ratio, batcher queue depth, gateway circuit events, and customer request traces.
nana (Support): Summary of action items (copy for records):
- kevin + maria: deploy kv-cache heuristic rollback canary -> promote on green (ETA 2h)
- danny: propose autoscale threshold changes and run load test (ETA 1d)
- liam: monitor post-promote p99/p999 for 30m (ongoing)
- ana (Support): customer comms and credit recommendations (ETA next 24h)
- kevin: draft postmortem and timeline (ETA 48h)
